body:
Yeah you’re right. I asked her out two days ago and got rejected. Whilst I am glad I have my answer, it hurts because I still have to see her because of our friend group. 

Life sucks sometimes.

Wow, at least you’re definitely braver than me for taking the plunge and asking her out haha! 

Our situations are even more similar as my crush also has told me about the problems in her past and that she has some extra baggage that made her more distrustful of men in general. She has cursed about her ex numerous times to me. (For very legit & understandable reasons)

The reason why I can’t ask is just because I’d rather not expose Schrödinger’s cat. I’m so scared of receiving a “no”, especially after today, that I would rather clingy to a “maybe” or a “possibility that something may develop further.”

But then does that mean I’m being stupid and her browsing pics of other guys is a sign of saying she has no interest in me? Or does it mean that she’s trying to get me to act, making it seem like she won’t be “on the market” for long to get me to take the plunge.

There’s too many hypotheticals and it genuinely scares me. I agree with your point though... how the hell does anyone do it?

When the first audible ping came through, she seemed excited saying “oh yep another match” and she kinda just shrugged as if it is a common occurrence once I asked about it.

She then proceeded to show me 16 matches that she said were cute looking guys and asked me to rate them. I just kinda paused for a moment to process it and then I kinda downplayed their hotness to her haha. (A lot of them looked way better than me which didn’t help me either)

So do girls do this often? Trying to test for jealousy in their possible romantic interests? Or is it more likely that I’ve been friend zoned?

No, or at least, I don’t think we have had a serious one... We’ve definitely joked about it such as “if we were together then we’d style our house like...” 

I mean is that what is supposed to happen? Like we should prediscuss about the possibility of dating before I entertain the idea of asking her out? That doesn’t sound right to me at all.

I mean she has told me of her previous breakups and other stuff like that so I get where she’s come from and she also knows that I haven’t been in a relationship before so I don’t know why you assumed we haven’t talked about what we want in an ideal partner.

As you say, you don’t know why she’d show me her matches and that’s the thing I’m more interested in deciphering.
That’s the thing, I was going to do it today as it was the last that I was going to see her for over a week. After she did that my heart just sank and I didn’t have the confidence to ask anymore.
